utterances.text: I think I can reach the pedal.
Yeah, I don't want you to do the pedals just yet. Gotta go over the arrows.
And then between where I can touch that little arrow.
Wait, what are you doing with your hands? You have to keep them at ten and two, exactly like I showed you. That's the only safe way to steer.
Grandpa, nobody actually drives like that anymore, it's so stiff. I can turn it just fine with one hand down here.
No, that's how accidents happen. You do it the proper way or we aren't moving. Now, turn.
Turn. Good job. Start letting it all out. There you go. Good. Turn a little more. Turn a little more. Oh, you parking?
